title: Cowaltz
blurb: A knight with an egg shield and a fairy princess with a bow defend a blue moon from bullet-hell bee swarms. Knock bees into bees for ricochet chains; every sting costs an EpiPen.
controls: Stick to move; Knight: BASH (shield blocks and reflects stingers); Fairy: hold SHOOT; tap a hero or their portrait to switch, the other is AI
